# Anne Shirley & Harrison

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) — neighborly friends · since v2  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), +1 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is interrupted while studying [Virgil](../codex/tech.md#virgil) by her angry new neighbor, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who complains about her Jersey cow trespassing in his oats. After a sharp exchange, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) pens up the cow and prepares tea for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). They discuss farm affairs and are soon joined by Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who shares local gossip about incoming neighbors and future students.
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) return from a shopping trip in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) discussing plans for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society). Upon seeing a Jersey cow in Mr. Harrison's oat field, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly assumes it is her own mischievous cow, chases it out with Diana's help, and impulsively sells it to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). After arriving home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers her real cow [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) in the barnyard and realizes she sold Mr. Harrison's cow, prompting her to set off to apologize to him with a nut cake peace offering.
>
> — v2 · II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Mr. Harrison's house to confess that she accidentally sold his Jersey cow to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) forgives her, agreeing to take Anne's cow in exchange, and invites her to stay for tea. After making tea and chatting together, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in high spirits and tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how well everything turned out.
>
> — v2 · III Mr. Harrison at Home

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) discuss their upcoming teaching roles and debate whether corporal punishment is effective or necessary in maintaining order. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks past various local landmarks and visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to manage students through affection rather than discipline. The next morning, a nervous [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her fears of failure with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) before starting her first day as a schoolteacher.
>
> — v2 · IV Different Opinions

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), encountering various eccentric neighbors, including a remarkably tidy woman and a father celebrating the birth of his new son. Capitalizing on the newborn boy's arrival, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) to make a generous donation. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a subscription, but he flatly refuses.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) discuss Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and the village improvement projects, including the plan to paint the local hall green. However, due to a mix-up with the paint numbers, [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a glaring bright blue with a red roof. Although the village is initially shocked by the hideous result, public sympathy shifts in favor of the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks home from school feeling content and meets [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) along the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path). When she arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs her that [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing, leading to a frantic search around the farm and well. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) locked [Dora](../character/dora.md) in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse and lied about it, but after a heart-to-heart conversation, she helps [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) understand the wrongness of lying before sending him to bed.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

> In a terrible mood caused by a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has a disaster-filled day at school, accidentally exploding a package of firecrackers brought by a student before whipping [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. After venting her shame and regret to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is surprised the next morning when Anthony treats her with new respect. Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later confirms that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has finally won Anthony over by giving him a proper whipping.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) on a springtime walk to celebrate her unofficial birthday. As they explore the woods and name a hidden pool, they discover the forgotten garden of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md), where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) shares the tragic love story behind it.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) joke about their anonymous newspaper prank and Uncle Abe's storm prediction, but an extraordinarily severe hail and thunder storm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on that exact date. The storm destroys crops, damages homes, kills Mr. Harrison's parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), and wrecks the trees planted by the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Afterwards, the community recovers and assesses the widespread damage, while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolve to replant their lost trees next spring.
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that Mr. Harrison's wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), has arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) looking for him, shocking the neighborhood. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) investigates the situation while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) brings home local gossip about the couple's past separation. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who reveals his newly scrubbed home and prepares to explain why he and his wife had parted ways.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) separated over his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), and how they have now reconciled. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets acquainted with Mrs. Harrison, who walks her back across the fields, before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to find [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) chatting with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and notices changes in the community during Sunday church, including the marriage of [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) and news that [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) is terminally ill. The next evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) to drop off jelly before going to see Ruby. At the Gillis home, Ruby tries to maintain a lively facade about her social life and future plans despite her deteriorating health.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XI The Round of Life

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her new story, "Averil's Atonement," with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), both of whom offer varying critiques. After finishing the manuscript, she submits it to two different publications, but receives rejections from both. Disheartened by the experience, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to lock the story away and give up her literary ambitions.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XII “Averil’s Atonement”

> Rebelling against Mrs. Lynde's strict instructions, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) drags [Dora](../character/dora.md) away from [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing and playing with the Cotton children. After returning home, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) lies to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) during dinner to cover up his disobedience, which leaves him feeling guilty. Later that night, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses his misdeeds to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who helps comfort him and explains the concept of conscience.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIII The Way of Transgressors

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) secretly submitted her rejected story to a baking powder contest with added ad plugs, which won first prize. Though horrified by the story's degradation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is comforted slightly by Gilbert's practical perspective after weeping over the situation.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XV A Dream Turned Upside Down

> As snow begins to fall, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) returns from grocery shopping and discusses household expenses with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then reads aloud an entertaining letter from [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), which details recent misadventures and funny incidents back home in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVII A Letter from Davy

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a snowbound [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday and finds herself feeling lonely while trying to navigate uncomfortable moments during Gilbert's visits. [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) engages [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in conversations about books, improper language, and town gossip. After Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) brings the mail, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns that Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) has passed away and left her a thousand dollars, guaranteeing her financial ability to continue at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl
